no.tittel: Puffs – or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic
no.ingress: En humoristisk ensemblekomedie om outsiderne på en magisk skole – fremført på engelsk.
no.tekst: «Puffs» følger elevene i huset Puffs gjennom sju kaotiske år, parallelt med historien om den berømte unge trollmannen. En forestilling om vennskap, motgang og tilhørighet, spilt på engelsk.

en.title: Puffs – or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic
en.lead: A humorous ensemble comedy about the outsiders at a magical school, performed in English.
en.text: “Puffs” follows the students of house Puffs through seven chaotic years, alongside the story of the famous young wizard. A play about friendship, adversity and belonging, performed in English.
